scope: Single-hero original-effect pilot; generic interpreter, no hero-name runtime branches. Vader basic chain is the acceptance fixture, not a claim of full Vader/all-client restoration.

fixes.problem: Exporter summed mutually exclusive Vader damage branches to 6.482
fixes.result: Preserve ordered references. Jedi OR Rebel selects unavoidable 3.241 branch; neither selects physical 3.241 branch. Both categories still one hit.
Lossless export of 63035 effects, 6732 abilities, seven shards. Generic capability validation before any turn/RNG/state mutation; unsupported graphs remain intact but disabled.

Independent instances and per-condition counts, FULLTURN start latch then end, OR expiry, basic permitted/special blocked. Normal chance100 also consumes RNG; ability-level evasion cache precedes effect filtering and chance; UNRESISTABLE bypasses resistance.

fixes.problem: Character mitigation incorrectly used ship level offset; shield treated incorrectly
fixes.result: Character denominator attackerLevel*7.5 + effectiveRating, percent/flat penetration, mitigation cap, special crit fields, original variance including zero RNG skip, attacker shield bypass and integer shield/HP split.

runtime_capability_scan.note: Coverage is graph/operator based, not per-hero adapters. Full data coverage does not equal full execution coverage.

verification.effect_export: 7 unittest cases PASS, complete raw graph equality and zero-chance fixture
verification.native_damage: PASS: native-supported damage, integer HP/shield, penetration, crit families, variance, evasion/resistance, rejection.

verification.manual_commands: PASS: waiting, invalid commands/RNG, legal targets, identities, choices, cooldown, determinism, auto and legacy.
verification.playmode: Exit 0. Actual UI raycast/pointer clicks, wait/no autonomous action, selected target, one original damage node, shield only HP unchanged, double click guard, auto on/off.
verification.player_smoke: Own built process alive 15 seconds; no exceptions/crash in dedicated log

remaining: Vader specials/passives and full kit are PENDING-ORIGINAL: DOT triggers, dispels, context counters, extra turns, stat modifiers, immunity and more target operators must be recovered generically.
Only selected alive enemy target rules and DAMAGE/CURSE modules are executable; unsupported fields/operators fail closed, no flattened approximation fallback in production loader.
Ships, unequal relic tier modifier tables and era/account progression hydration not connected.
Offline auto policy selects supported basic; this is not the original AI/FSM reconstruction.
Post-damage health steal, counter/assist hooks and leader/passive initialization are not restored; this pilot proves direct damage and CURSE operators, not complete original combat equivalence.
Scene visuals/camera/UI still diverge from original. This task validates effect execution, not visual fidelity.
Original evidence is static native bodies plus matching artifact identity. Controlled replay validates this port, not a live server battle capture.
next_generic_operators: Persisted triggered effects and START_OF_TURN events for damage-over-time
All-target selection and stat modifier groups
Context counters and ordered dispels, then extra-turn scheduling
